app.name: ExcellentPDF
command.reading_ruler_invert: Reading ruler: dim the page around it
command.step_left: Left: scroll, or the pages on the left
command.step_right: Right: scroll, or the pages on the right
command.leave_modes: Leave full screen and reading modes
sticky.name: Sticky note
sticky.placing_hint: Click on a page to put a sticky note there. %{key} again calls it off.
text.placing_hint: Click on a page to put a text box there, then type in the inspector. %{key} again calls it off.
text.placing_typewriter_hint: Click on a page, such as a form's blank, to type there. %{key} again calls it off.
text.label: Text
text.saved_hint: Drawn on the page in a standard font, so other readers show it the same.
callout.name: Callout
callout.placing: Click what the callout points at
callout.placing_hint: Click on a page where the arrow goes; the box goes beside it. %{key} again calls it off.
line.name: Line
arrow.name: Arrow
line.placing_hint: Drag on a page from where it starts to where it ends; hold Shift for steps of 15°. %{key} again calls it off.
rectangle.name: Rectangle
ellipse.name: Ellipse
rectangle.placing_hint: Drag on a page from one corner to the other; hold Shift for a square. %{key} again calls it off.
ellipse.placing_hint: Drag on a page from one corner of its box to the other; hold Shift for a circle. %{key} again calls it off.
polygon.name: Polygon
polyline.name: Polyline
cloud.name: Cloud
polygon.placing_hint: Click each corner on a page; double-click, or click the first corner, to finish. Hold Shift to keep a side at 15° steps. %{key} again calls it off.
polyline.placing_hint: Click each point on a page and double-click the last. Hold Shift to keep a side at 15° steps. %{key} again calls it off.
cloud.placing_hint: Click round the area on a page; double-click, or click the first corner, to close the cloud. %{key} again calls it off.
regular_polygon.placing_hint: Drag on a page from one corner of its box to the other; hold Shift to keep it even. The sides are set in Settings. %{key} again calls it off.
star.placing_hint: Drag on a page from one corner of its box to the other; hold Shift to keep it even. The points are set in Settings. %{key} again calls it off.
settings.polygon_sides_hint: How many sides the regular polygon tool draws, 3 to 32
settings.star_points_hint: How many points the star tool draws, 3 to 32
margin.label: Notes in the margin
margin.heading: %{kind}; %{author}
settings.margin_notes_hint: Show each note as a card beside the pages, level with what it is about
inspector.author: Author
inspector.lock_hint: Keeps its place, size and look; its note can still be written
inspector.locked: This annotation is locked, so it can't be moved, restyled or deleted. Turn off Locked to change it.
annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.no_document: Open a PDF to list its annotations.
annotations.empty: This document has no annotations yet. Highlight text or add a note, and it shows here.
annotations.none_match: No annotation matches. Clear the search or the filters to see them all.
annotations.search: Search notes, marked text and tags (tag:name)
annotations.color_chosen: Showing only %{color}; press to show every colour
transfer.pick: Choose the version to take annotations from
transfer.same_detail: Choose another version of this document, such as the preprint of a published paper.
transfer.nothing_detail: None of the other version's %{count} annotations could be placed here: its text isn't in this document.
transfer.title: Add %{count} annotations from the other version?
transfer.summary: Found where they were: %{placed}. Found elsewhere or with changed text: %{moved}. Kept on the same page and place (they mark no text): %{in_place}. Not found, so not added: %{orphaned}.
category.title: Category
category.question: Question
tags.title: Tags
annotations.show_only: Show only matching on the pages
stamps.placing: Choose a stamp, then click the page
stamps.placing_hint: Click on a page to put the stamp there. %{key} again calls it off.
stamps.dynamic: With your name and the time
stamps.library_empty: Import a PDF or an image to keep it here as a stamp.
stamps.import_pick: Choose a PDF or an image for a stamp
stamps.import_failed: The stamp could not be imported
stamps.remove_failed: The stamp could not be removed
stamps.failed: The stamp could not be placed
threads.title: Replies
command.layers_by_author: Put annotations on one layer per author
layers.title: Layers
layers.empty: No layers yet. Give each reviewer one, or type a layer name in an annotation's inspector.
exchange.exported_detail: They are in %{name}. Acrobat and other PDF readers can import it.
exchange.summary: %{added} added; %{updated} updated; %{unchanged} already here; %{skipped} left out (locked here, or on a page this document lacks). Undo takes them all back.
flatten.title: Export flattened copy
flatten.same_detail: A flattened copy can't replace the document you have open: its annotations would no longer be editable.
flatten.done_detail: %{name} shows the annotations as part of its pages; they can no longer be moved or edited. This document is unchanged.
snapshot.title: Snapshot of page %{page}
favorites.title: Pen
favorites.full_detail: It holds 12 pens. Remove one to save another.
favorites.not_pens: The file isn't a set of pens exported from ExcellentPDF.
favorites.newer: The file comes from a newer ExcellentPDF. Update the app to read it.
favorites.empty: The file holds no pen this version knows.
note.heading: %{kind} on page %{page}
note.label: Note
note.saved_hint: Kept in the PDF as the markup's comment, so other readers show it too.
note.empty_hint: Click a highlight to read or write its note
settings.annotation_palette_hint: The colours the markup tools offer
command.outline_open_elsewhere: Open outline entry in other pane
outline.check.ok: All %{count} entries open a place in this document.
outline.check.found: They are marked in the outline. Fix broken outline entries points each one at the heading with its title, or removes it when there is none.
outline.fix.done: Pointed at their headings: %{repointed}. Removed, with no heading found: %{removed}. Undo brings them back as they were.
command.select_all: Select all text on this page
goto.title: Go to page
goto.hint: Type a page number or label, then press Enter
link.file.title: Open a file from this document?
link.file.body: This link opens a file or starts a program on your computer. Open it only if you trust this document.
link.protocol.title: Open this link?
link.protocol.body: This link opens another app. You can let links like it open without asking in Settings.
link.refused.title: This link won't run
link.refused.body: It runs a script or opens hidden data, which ExcellentPDF never does.
palette.title: Command palette
document.empty.title: No document open
document.missing.title: %{name} wasn't found
document.missing.hint: It was in %{place}. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
locate.title: Locate %{name}
document.empty.hint: Press %{open} to open a document, or %{keys} to see every command
pages.empty: Open a document to see its pages here
outline.empty: Open a document to see its outline here
outline.add_first: Add an entry for this page
outline.title: Entry title
outline.read_only: This document's outline can't be changed
outline.read_only_detail: Only the outlines of PDF files can be edited.
bookmark.empty: Open a document to keep your own bookmarks in it
bookmark.none: Save places to come back to. Press %{keys} to bookmark the one you are reading.
bookmark.title: Title
bookmark.delete_detail: Its note and tags are deleted with it.
recover.label: Recovered changes
recover.bar: The app closed before these changes were saved, so they're back: %{changes}. Keep them, or discard them and keep the file as it is on disk.
thumbnails.title: Pages
thumbnails.page_current: Page %{page}, the page you are reading
inspector.empty: Properties and comments will show here
theme.picker.title: Theme
theme.picker.placeholder: Pick a theme. Enter keeps it, Esc goes back
appearance.picker.title: Appearance
appearance.picker.placeholder: Pick light or dark. Enter keeps it, Esc goes back
settings.title: Settings
settings.saved_as_you_go: Changes are saved as you make them
settings.tab_cycle_hint: Recently used goes back and forth between the last tabs; tab order goes along the strip
settings.document_colors_hint: Smart takes the theme's text and paper, and leaves photos and artwork as they are
settings.reading_theme_hint: The paper and ink the pages are drawn in; you see each one on the page as you move through them
settings.reading_custom_hint: The paper and ink of the Custom reading theme, as #rrggbb
reading_theme.title: Reading theme
settings.theme_hint: The colours of the window around your documents
settings.language_hint: The language of the window's text; a right-to-left language mirrors it
settings.follow_system_contrast_hint: While Windows' high contrast is on, every theme uses its high-contrast colours
settings.appearance_hint: Follow the system, or always use one
settings.ruler_color_hint: The tint of the band on the line you are reading
settings.ruler_height_hint: It grows to hold a taller line
settings.ruler_opacity_hint: How strongly the band, or the dimmed page, is tinted
settings.ruler_invert: Dim the page around the ruler
settings.ruler_invert_hint: Instead of tinting the band itself
settings.focus_scope_hint: What stays bright around the line you are reading
settings.auto_scroll_speed_hint: Where auto-scroll starts; + and − change it as it runs
settings.reflow_font_size_hint: EPUB, FB2, MOBI, HTML and Markdown books lay their pages out again at this size
settings.link_protocols_hint: Protocols, separated by commas; other links ask first
settings.ref_preview_hint: Rest the pointer on a reference such as [12] or (Smith, 2020) to see its entry; click the preview to go there
settings.ref_preview_delay_hint: How long the pointer rests before the preview shows
settings.shortcuts_hint: Kept in settings.toml under [shortcuts]. Grey keys work while the pages have the keyboard
open.title: Open
tabs.search: Search tabs by name or folder
recent.title: Recent
tab_group.title: Tab group
tab_group.name: Group name
command.move_tab_next_pane: Move tab to the next pane
command.move_tab_previous_pane: Move tab to the previous pane
command.pop_out: Move tab to its own window or back
command.flip_panes: Flip panes between side by side and stacked
settings.sync_scroll_hint: While on, other panes follow the one you move: by page number, by position through the document, or by pages you paired
settings.sync_zoom_hint: Synced panes take the zoom of the pane you move
window.dock: Move tabs back to the main window
pane.drop_left: Drop to open on the left
pane.drop_right: Drop to open on the right
settings.close_pane_tabs_hint: Its tabs can move to the pane beside it, or close and wait in Reopen closed tab
command.new_workspace_from_tab: Move tab to a new workspace
workspace.name: Name
workspace.delete_hint: Its %{count} tabs can move to %{other}, or close and be gone with it. Edits are already saved.
workspace.exported: Saved %{name} to %{file}. Files in its folder are kept relative, so they can move together.
workspace.export_failed: Couldn't save %{file}. Check that the folder can be written to.
workspace.import_failed: %{file} isn't a workspace file ExcellentPDF can read.
workspace.import_too_new: %{file} is from a newer ExcellentPDF. Update the app to import it.
workspace.imported_missing: %{name} is here, but %{count} of its files aren't where the workspace file says. Their tabs are greyed out; open one and choose Locate… to find it.
settings.open_elsewhere: A file open in another workspace
settings.open_elsewhere_hint: Opening it can switch to that workspace, or open it here as well
find.more: %{n} more not listed here; narrow the search, or step through them all with Next
find.empty: Press %{keys} to find words in the document. Every result lists here with the words round it.
find.no_document: Open a document to search it
home.title: Home
home.no_match: No recent file matches. The tab list (%{keys}) searches every file you opened.
print.printed_one: Sent 1 page of %{name} to the printer
print.printed: Sent %{pages} pages of %{name} to the printer
print.no_pages: the pages chosen aren't in the document
print.unsupported: printing on this system comes in a later version
settings.print_scaling_hint: How each page fits the printer's paper; a page turns to match the paper's shape
settings.print_annotations_hint: Highlights, notes and ink print with the page; form fields always do
guide.title: Getting started
guide.open.title: Open a document
guide.open.body: Press %{open} to choose files, or drop them on the window. Each one opens in its own tab, and the app remembers where you stopped reading.
guide.read.title: Pick a mode, make reading yours
guide.read.body: The bar under the tabs switches between Read, Annotate and Present, each with its own tools; Customize changes them. Layouts, page colours and the reading ruler are in Settings (%{settings}).
guide.palette.title: Every command, one key away
guide.palette.body: Press %{palette} and type what you want to do: find, print, rotate, a theme. The list shows each command's shortcut as well.
tip.palette: Tip: press %{keys} to find any command by typing its name.
tip.tab_list: Tip: %{keys} lists every open tab; type to find one.
settings.show_tips_hint: A one-line tip below the pages, once, the first time it helps
settings.guide_hint: The three steps shown when the app first starts
toolbar.empty: No tools here yet; Customize adds them
toolbar.customize_hint: Each mode has its own toolbar. Drag a tool by its name to move it, or use its arrows.
toolbar.export_failed: Couldn't save %{name}. Check that the folder can be written to.
toolbar.imported_some: Took the %{modes} toolbars from %{name}; %{count} tools this version doesn't have were left out.
toolbar.newer: %{name} comes from a newer version of ExcellentPDF; update the app to use it.
settings.pen_to_write_hint: Touching a page with a pen switches to Write mode, once Write has tools
settings.finger_draws_hint: A finger draws ink on the page instead of scrolling. A hand resting on the screen while you write never does
settings.toolbar_hint: Choose and order each mode's tools, or share them as a preset
